products.title: Dell Latitude 3450 Laptop – Intel Core Ultra 7 155U, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB SSD, 14-inch Full HD Display, Intel Iris Graphics, DOS, Grey, English/Arabic Keyboard
products.raw_description:
The Dell Latitude 3450 laptop features an Intel Core Ultra 7-155U processor with a speed of 1.7 GHz and 12 cores. It includes 16GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB SSD storage, and a 14-inch Full HD display with a resolution of 1920x1080. The laptop features Intel Iris graphics, a grey finish, and an English/Arabic keyboard. It runs DOS (Free DOS) without Windows. Explore the Dell Latitude 3450 laptop specifications at Compumarts in Egypt.
